baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same root governs the promise that comes and the divine act of bringing the addressees.
baseline_models.mechanism: The conditional makes one arrival switch on another: when the later appointment arrives, the speaker brings the addressed collective into a mixed assembled state.

activation_trace.role: Coming or occurring supplies the repeated motion verb and links the arriving event to the ensuing divine action.
Bringing and presenting something makes the second coming transitive: the addressees are the transported object.
An appointment bounded by time or place gives the first arrival a determinate trigger function.
Laterness after a prior term places the appointment at the far side of the dwelling phase.
Diverse people folded into one company supplies the resulting state of the transported collective.

changed_reading.before: A future promise is followed by a gathering.
changed_reading.after: The promise is an arriving switch: its occurrence immediately becomes divine transport, producing one mixed collective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command to dwell on the earth is opposed by the later act of bringing the same plural addressees.
baseline_models.mechanism: Authorized habitation arrests movement for an interval; the final clause reopens movement and removes the settled collective from dispersed residences into one assembly.

activation_trace.role: Succession after what precedes starts a staged temporal sequence rather than an undifferentiated command.
Loss of motion makes dwelling the arrested phase that the final bringing reverses.
Inhabiting a home locates that arrested phase in ordinary residence.
The lower terrestrial surface supplies the distributed field of habitation.
Divine bringing restarts motion and transfers the residents into a new collective state.
A mixed company replaces spatially distributed residence with social and spatial intermixture.

changed_reading.before: The verse grants residence and separately predicts a later meeting.
changed_reading.after: Residence is a bounded pause in a mobility regime: settlement is authorized now, but final remobilization and recomposition remain with the speaker.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The addressee is named through descent, while its terminal state is a mixed company.
baseline_models.mechanism: The lineage term supplies inherited affiliation, but the final collective can include varied groups and persons attached and counted among them; corporate identity is continuous without being socially unmixed.

activation_trace.role: Descent and attribution to an origin establish lineage while allowing affiliation through upbringing, service, or attachment.
People from differing groups, including those who attach and are counted among a people, make the terminal body composite.

changed_reading.before: Children of Israel denotes a fixed homogeneous descent group gathered intact.
changed_reading.after: The address preserves descent-based continuity yet ends with a porous, internally varied corporate body rather than a pedigree-pure unit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior explicit gathering drives a group toward a destination on the resurrection day; this converts the focus clause from a neutral reunion into a directed terminal muster.

activation_trace.role: Driving and collecting a group toward a destination supplies coercive direction to the focus act of bringing.
Resurrection and the rising of the Hour place the nearby gathering at a terminal time horizon.
Bringing the addressees gives the focus clause the transport action sharpened by the prior muster.
The mixed company is the collected result at the destination.

structural_cues: 17:97 uses first-person divine gathering before 17:104 uses first-person divine bringing, creating a directional parallel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit resurrection-day muster and the focus supplies divine transport into a mixed body; I infer a shared terminal collection mechanism. A live alternative is that the third-person group in 17:97 and the second-person group in 17:104 remain separate referents and actions.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are simply brought together at a later time.
changed_reading.after: They are driven toward an appointed terminal destination and constituted there as a mixed muster.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fragmentation, rousing from stillness, renewed creation, and a fixed term turn the mixed gathering into reconstitution after bodily and temporal dispersal.

activation_trace.role: Pulverization into debris supplies the prior state from which the focus collective must be recovered.
Rousing what is motionless supplies the transition from dispersed remains to mobile persons.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the reconstructive power behind divine bringing.
A prescribed temporal limit sharpens the focus promise as an endpoint rather than an indefinite future.
Bringing and presenting supplies the recovery action at the fixed endpoint.
Intermixed plurality becomes the reconstituted social result rather than mere spatial proximity.

structural_cues: 17:98-99 move from bones and debris through renewed creation to an unquestioned term immediately before the Moses-Israel sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily fragmentation, reanimation, recreation, and a fixed term; I infer that the focus bringing can collect persons across death and dispersion. A live alternative is a historical or geopolitical regathering within ordinary life.

changed_reading.before: The mixed body is assembled from geographically separated living groups.
changed_reading.after: The mixed body may be reconstituted across bodily fragmentation and death when the prescribed term arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby contrast between possessing reserves and withholding them makes the focus choice of inhabit rather than own legally salient; final divine transport confirms that residence is not absolute control.

activation_trace.role: Ownership with power of disposal supplies the unspoken legal alternative to merely inhabiting the land.
Withholding wealth through stinginess shows the exclusionary behavior attached to imagined possession.
Habitation grants a place to live without itself asserting ownership or unlimited disposal.
The earth is the inhabited domain whose legal status is being distinguished from possession.
The speaker's later power to bring the residents away limits any inference of permanent proprietary control.

structural_cues: 17:100 says possess and withhold; 17:104 says dwell and then be brought, preserving a lexical contrast between control and residence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit possession and withholding near a command of habitation; I infer provisional tenure rather than proprietary title. A live alternative is that 17:100 concerns only human stinginess toward mercy and does not qualify land tenure.

changed_reading.before: The command to dwell can sound like an unrestricted land grant.
changed_reading.after: The command authorizes residence, but not absolute ownership: occupancy remains bounded by the speaker's final power of transfer.

context_deltas.mechanism: An attempted destabilization from the earth is answered by the aggressor's total removal and a command that restores the threatened group to stable habitation; final remobilization is thereby reserved to divine agency.

activation_trace.role: Lightness that shakes stability supplies the attempted uprooting that the command to dwell directly reverses.
The same terrestrial domain is first the object of expulsion and then the field of authorized residence.
Lethal drowning removes the attempted displacer and opens the post-him settlement phase.
Complete inclusion without remainder makes the removal of the prior power total.
Afterward binds the residence command to the completed removal in the preceding scene.
Stability after motion is the exact counterforce to attempted destabilization.
Final divine transport distinguishes legitimate terminal movement from the failed human expulsion.

structural_cues: 17:103 attempts to unsettle them from the earth; 17:104 begins after him and commands Children of Israel to settle the earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted uprooting, complete drowning, and immediate post-him settlement; I infer an intentional reversal in which control of collective movement changes hands. A live alternative is that after him is only chronological and the final bringing is independent of the expulsion scene.

changed_reading.before: The dwelling command is generic resettlement after a ruler's death.
changed_reading.after: It is a counter-decree that restores stability after attempted expulsion, while reserving any final removal and assembly to divine agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following image of delivery in separated portions with deliberate waiting activates the focus sequence as an interval architecture: dispersed residence persists through measured time and ends in recombination.

activation_trace.role: Repeated delivery and conveyance supply a process distributed through stages rather than one instantaneous transition.
Separation into parts supplies the dispersive phase that a final mixed gathering can reverse.
Stability joined to waiting supplies the temporal texture of the commanded dwelling.
The packet's split mapping to counted or recurrent time lets the promise function as a measured terminus.
Deferral to a later time stretches the interval between settlement and collection.
Mixed assembly supplies the recombined endpoint after portioning and delay.

structural_cues: 17:105-106 repeat descent, explicitly separate the recitation, and prescribe waiting; 17:104 is itself ordered by after, when, and later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies staged portions and deliberate waiting, while the focus supplies a timed endpoint and mixed collection; I infer a dispersion-through-time then recombination pattern. A live alternative is that portioning applies only to recitation cadence and has no bearing on the history of the addressed people.

changed_reading.before: The verse jumps directly from residence to an unspecified future assembly.
changed_reading.after: Residence fills a measured, internally staged interval whose terminal operation recombines what time and space have separated.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recited speech moves bodies, and the repeated promise is named as something enacted; the focus saying, arriving promise, and divine bringing therefore form a speech-to-event-to-action circuit.

activation_trace.role: Embodied falling in response to recitation shows transmitted speech producing immediate bodily movement.
The repeated promise is an expressed commitment whose fulfillment is expected rather than a detached forecast.
The creation of an act turns the promise into something performed and operational.
The opening utterance begins the focus circuit in voiced speech.
The commitment carried in speech bridges the opening decree and its later execution.
Bringing the addressees is the concrete action by which the commitment becomes embodied.

structural_cues: 17:107-109 sequence recitation, bodily falling, the declaration that the promise is enacted, and renewed falling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recited speech, bodily response, and a promise called enacted; I infer a performative chain culminating in the focus transport. A live alternative is that the response merely testifies to certainty and does not model how the final assembly occurs.

changed_reading.before: The promise predicts an event that later happens.
changed_reading.after: The promise is an executable commitment: utterance advances into event and then into an action that physically relocates its addressees.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the harvest image comes from the packet's form-distant split mapping of و ع د to ع و م, not from the ordinary lexical sense of promise. It remains anchored through that explicit packet mapping, the focus mixed collective, and the nearby separation into portions. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy for incremental reaggregation, never a direct gloss of وعد.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split وعد inventory includes gathering cut material handful by handful, while لفيفا names the final mixed company.

activation_trace.role: Gathering harvested material grip by grip until it forms one mass gives the promise endpoint a material collection image.
A heterogeneous company joined into one body supplies the human counterpart to the gathered mass.
Distribution into portions supplies a prior stage from which gradual reaggregation can proceed.

changed_reading.before: The final gathering occurs as a single undifferentiated collection.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the terminal mixed body resembles a harvest accumulated portion by portion after a long phase of separation.

strongest_changes: The explicit muster in 17:97 makes the final bringing directional and terminal rather than a neutral reunion.
Fragmentation, resurrection, recreation, and a fixed term in 17:98-99 expand the gathering across death and bodily dispersal.
The expulsion attempt in 17:103 turns dwelling into a counter-decree and reserves final collective movement to divine agency.
The enacted promise in 17:108 makes the focus sequence an operative speech-to-action circuit.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated جاء creates an event-action relay; the opposition of سكن to استفز and جئنا makes control of movement central; and بني beside لفيفا permits continuity of lineage without social homogeneity.
remaining_uncertainties: The final second-person plural may remain restricted to Children of Israel or may widen within the terminal gathering frame.
The later promise may be an ultimate eschatological event or a later historical appointment, although the nearby muster and resurrection language strengthen the former.
The counted-time and harvest readings depend on explicit but form-distant split mappings and must remain exploratory.
